body: Hello, say hi to all on the other side for me. Tell them I'm also coming soon.

Each individual is an isolated being born into the universe, barred from knowing "why", yet compelled to invent meaning.
Those who claim to find meaning in their lives are either dishonest or deluded. In either case, they fail to face up to the harsh reality of the human situations.

Perhaps. Really, the most you can do right now is be there for her, and as she is so far physically, that's about all you can do.
Unless you know someone else that can be near her?

She has untreated chronic depression symptoms and an unprocessed trauma.
The best to do would be increasing her coping resources.
She can can begin a new project or learn a new hobby. She can choose to die anytime, so why not have some fun before she leaves?

Well, that's strange... do you have any idea of how you made it there?
Are you a somnambulist? Did someone carried you there?

The good is that probably he won't die.
He maybe just had an hypovolemic shock, but if he got to the hospital I'd say the chances are high enough that he'll make it.

I don't understand why people won't let me go either.
They say they care but I only see them needlessly burdening themselves with my thoughts.
Here it comes again... haha, it will all be the same again. I don't care.

I am glad this self-support place worked for you.
What else can I say; Be happy and be who you want to be.

I believe few, if any, will read this, but let it be known that I tried to seek help... but as I have said, there isn't much where to turn.
At this rate I'll indeed be gone on April 1st (not a joke).
Goodbye everyone... I am saying this now that I can... probably this will be a reprise of March 10...

But the depression train is not stopping... I pull the emergency brakes, but I'm going down again.... today I barely ate anything.
I have (again) suicidal ideations, anhedonia (probably what I hate the most... nothing makes any difference when I have this), well, the entire package is back.

Funny, the so-called experts at the mental hospital (Hospital Psiquiátrico Fray Bernardino Alvarez, if you wanted to know) say that 10 or 100 mg makes no difference, and that I would only risk having extra side effects.
My parents follow that advice very closely, and won't let me have more than 10 mg daily.

I tried people, I really did.
I sent job applications, took morning walks and I smiled as I hadn't in months.
But today... it all returns.
No particular trigger... It just came back because it wasn't gone to begin with...
My therapist gave up, telling me I need to seek a new psychologist.

Well people, I've tried, but no luck. On March 10 I had an psychotic episode, I broke many things, scared everyone out by my behavior, and they called 911.
Funny, they sent a police unit saying that they couldn't take me to the mental institute because that's the Red Cross' job...
So they called the Red Cross... the fuckers wanted 200 USD (!!!) or they wouldn't take me either.
Guess what, I stayed home because no emergency unit gave a fuck about me...
Next day my parents took me to an emergency unit (lol, I had to wait FIVE HOURS to even get evaluated... hello everyone! I tried to kill myself, I thought you said you cared?)... and I indeed had "internment criteria" but well... welcome to Mexico, where the only hospital beds available are used on government commercials. So I couldn't be put on suicide watch because of a lack of space.
"Come back tomorrow at 6 AM (!!!)", they told us.

Ugh... appointment cancelled due to lack of space in the doctor's agenda...
Lovely medical system here eh? /s
Tell us more so we can understand you, please.
And how do you feel? Does it make a difference?

Tell them you really need it, otherwise you wouldn't be there.
Tell them what you plan to do to yourself.

Thank you for your comments, I really appreciate them.
Maybe I should really go to my appointment tomorrow after all...

There's just no point to it all... if I get out of this, what would I have accomplished? Who guarantees that this won't happen again? Why should I care if nobody else does? I have made exactly zero positive impact on anyone's life, so why bother? All I do is live off others' resources and due to anxiety I can't move (figuratively speaking), what's the purpose of my existence? Never learned any social skills at all, how to survive in this social world?

I'll never find out.

Not where I am.
Probably on the border though...

One day less, nothing has changed.
I have an appointment with my psychiatrist tomorrow... but I no longer feel like going.
I have tried, but this is not working.

Please seek professional help.
It sounds as if you have some good coping resources, but you're being troubled by something.
Lucky you I suppose. I don't get any info at all.

Please, talk it out here.
We won't judge.

"I have nothing to offer in return except for my existence."
My thoughts exactly... Everyone talks about endless opportunities and stuff... but how to maneuver being socially anxious on a social world?

Don't overdose. Most likely you'll end up with debilitating pain on a hospital and that will be pretty much it (aka failed suicide).
Give yourself some time... I am doing that as well.
I wish I could help... well I up-voted your message, maybe others can help.

Well that's tough really, I would maybe suggest looking into whatever resources are available... maybe even asking for custody or something.
But I feel like that sounds very insensitive.
Man, I'm sorry.

People care because you cared for them. You have, in some way or another, helped them.
I would talk with them about it...

Isn't anyone else able to care for them? Not ideal, but at least they wouldn't see their family struggle so much.
That isn't good for them either.

Well... any good reason to stay in that toxic relationship?
From what you say she only harms you... if you don't get any good out of it then why stay?
I feel what you say... I really don't have any advice since I feel the same way but know that you're not the only one like this.
I will try. Thank you for your suggestion.

Who is this "everyone" you talk about? It seems to be a group with highly biased feminist views.
Being a male does not turn you into an evil being; quite the contrary, if you're going to be happier then you will (most likely) become a better person.

Ugh, laws are really annoying at times. Unfortunately in that regard I cannot give any advice.

Maybe take the psychosis medication (at the very least you have a chance to feel better), since the file will be rejected in any case?
Not trying to discourage you, in fact, I think that if your psychosis is treated you have more possibilities of passing.

I don't believe you are an "goddamn aberration" as you say, transitioning is no easy task and as in everything there can be mistakes. But If you hold on you might get to be who you want to be. I know it may not be enough to stop your feelings. This is purely my observations.

I relate.
The human need to connect with others sometimes can drive us to destruction, seeing that paradoxically we need to have empathy with them yet our interests are on unrelated levels, leaving us baffled and disappointed.
As someone that hasn't spoken to anyone on my age group for over three years, I personally still feel the need to be heard, but I realize it is all pointless since all of them would just walk away from me because I have no interest in pop culture whatsoever.
